title: Yara and the Well
author: Lior Nystrom
blurb: Elodie Almeida, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
